faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Got questions? Here is everything you need to know about calculating YouTube playlist lengths.

items.q: How do I calculate YouTube playlist length?
items.a: Paste your YouTube playlist URL into the calculator above and click Calculate. The tool uses the YouTube Data API to fetch every video in the playlist and sum their durations to give you the exact total length in hours, minutes, and seconds.

items.q: Can I calculate watch time at 1.5x or 2x speed?
items.a: Yes. After calculating your playlist, the Speed Comparison table shows the adjusted watch time at 0.5x, 0.75x, 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x, 1.75x, 2x, 2.25x, 2.5x, and 3x. You can also enter a completely custom speed like 1.3x or 2.7x.

items.q: Can I calculate only part of a playlist?
items.a: Yes. Use the "Range" mode to specify a start and end video number. For example, set Start: 10, End: 50 to calculate only videos 10 through 50. Use "Remaining" mode to calculate how much is left after a specific video.

items.q: Why are some videos missing from my results?
items.a: Some videos may be unavailable due to being private, deleted, region-restricted, or removed by the uploader. These are counted and labeled in the results, but their duration cannot be fetched via the YouTube API.

The calculation is precise — it uses the exact duration metadata from the YouTube Data API for each individual video. However, private, deleted, or unavailable videos are excluded. Live streams report 0 seconds until they end.

items.q: Does this tool store my playlist URL?
items.a: No. Your URL is used only to make a temporary request to the YouTube API. It is not stored, logged, or used for any other purpose. See our Privacy Policy for full details.

items.q: Do I need a YouTube API key?
items.a: No — the tool works without you needing to provide one. We handle API access on our server. Power users who have their own YouTube API key can optionally use it to bypass shared quota limits.

items.q: Can I calculate a single YouTube video?
items.a: Yes. Paste any YouTube video URL (youtube.com/watch?v=... or youtu.be/...) and it will return the video duration along with speed-adjusted watch times.
Yes. YT Playlist Cal is completely free, with no paid plans, no signup, and no usage limits for normal use.

items.q: Is this tool affiliated with YouTube or Google?
items.a: No. YT Playlist Cal is an independent utility and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with YouTube or Google LLC.

about.title: About YT Playlist Cal
about.subtitle: YT Playlist Cal is a free, fast, and privacy-conscious tool for calculating the total duration of any public YouTube playlist.
about.whatWeDoP1: YouTube doesn't show you the total length of a playlist. If you're a student planning to finish a programming course, someone binge-watching a series, or a teacher reviewing content — you often need to know the total time commitment upfront.
about.whatWeDoP2: YT Playlist Cal solves that problem: paste any YouTube playlist URL and instantly get the total duration, along with watch-time estimates at different playback speeds (1×, 1.5×, 2×, or custom), a per-video breakdown, and a daily watch planner.
